trial_name.text: IOM-104E (CT head and body) — blinded re-read of studies 48,848-007A, -007B, -008A, -008B

phase.text: Blinded re-read of prospective, randomized, double-blind, parallel group phase 3 imaging studies

citations.quote: Study Design: Blinded re-read of prospective, randomized, double-blind, parallel group clinical studies.

Study IOM-104E was an off-site blinded reading of images obtained from patients enrolled in four head or body CT studies (48848-007A, 48848-007B, 48848-008A, and 48848-008B), which were all phase 3, multicenter, double-blind, parallel, randomized control studies with balanced designs.

endpoint.text: % adequate visualization on a 2-point scale and non-inferiority to comparator (10% non-inferiority margin)

citations.quote:
% adequate visualization on a
2-point scale and non-inferiority to compar

The primary objective of IOM-104E was to demonstrate non-inferiority of Iomervu to the comparator in the proportion of patients with adequate quality of opacification and anatomic visualization using a 10% non-inferiority margin.

n.text: 59 patients received Iomervu 400 mg/mL (vs 55 iopamidol 370) and 59 received Iomervu 250 mg/mL (vs 57 iopamidol 250)

result.text: At least 98% (lower bound of 95% CI at least 91%) of image sets in Iomervu and comparator groups were rated adequate; the largest between-group difference was 1.7 (95% CI -1.6, 5.0), within the 10% non-inferiority margin

citations.quote: at least 98% (lower bound of 95% CI at least 91%) of image sets in the Iomervu and comparator groups were rated as having adequate quality visualization, defined as fair, good, or excellent (score of 3-5) on a 5 point scale, by all readers (Table 42).

indication.text: IOMERVU is a radiographic contrast agent indicated for intravenous procedures: CT of the head and body; CT angiography of intracranial, visceral, and lower extremity arteries; coronary CT angiography; and CT urography in adults and pediatric patients (NDA 216017 covers the intravenous indications); the shared label also covers intra-arterial procedures.

citations.quote: IOMERVU is a radiographic contrast agent indicated for:

- Computed tomography (CT) of the head and body in adults and pediatric patients
- CT angiography of intracranial, visceral, and lower extremity arteries in adults and pediatric patients
- Coronary CT angiography in adults and pediatric patients
- CT urography in adults and pediatric patients
New drug application (NDA) 216017, for IV indications, and NDA 216016, for IA indications, were submitted approximately 2 weeks apart.

target_moa.text: Iomeprol is a radiographic iodinated contrast agent that opacifies the vessels and body structures where it is present following intravenous or intra-arterial administration, permitting radiographic visualization of internal structures through attenuation of X-ray photons.

citations.quote: **Mechanism of Action:** Iomeprol is a radiographic iodinated contrast agent that opacifies the vessels and body structures where the contrast agent is present following intravenous or intra-arterial administration, permitting radiographic visualization of the internal structures through attenuation of X-ray photons.

modality.text: Small molecule — iodinated radiographic contrast agent (iomeprol), a new molecular entity

citations.quote: Iomervu (iomeprol) injection is an iodinated radiographic contrast agent that opacifies the vessels and body structures where the contrast agent is present following intravascular administration, permitting visualization of the internal structures through attenuation of x-ray photons.
Iomeprol has not been approved in the United States and is a new molecular entity (NME).

key_safety.text: Safety evaluated in 4,923 patients, of whom 4,804 received up to the recommended total iodine dose of 86 grams. Most common adverse reactions (incidence ≥0.5%) are feeling hot (1.8%), headache (1.1%), nausea (1.0%), chest pain (0.6%), back pain (0.5%), and vomiting (0.5%). Serious adverse reactions occurred in 28 patients (0.6%). Serious risks include life-threatening or fatal hypersensitivity reactions, acute kidney injury, and cardiovascular adverse reactions.

citations.quote: The safety of Iomervu was evaluated in 4,923 patients, of whom 4,804 patients received Iomervu at up to the recommended total iodine dose of 86 grams.

detail.text: WARNING: RISKS ASSOCIATED WITH INTRATHECAL ADMINISTRATION — intrathecal administration, even if inadvertent, may cause death, convulsions, cerebral hemorrhage, coma, paralysis, arachnoiditis, acute renal failure, cardiac arrest, seizures, rhabdomyolysis, hyperthermia, and brain edema. IOMERVU is for intra-arterial or intravenous use only.

citations.quote: ## WARNING: RISKS ASSOCIATED WITH INTRATHECAL ADMINISTRATION

Intrathecal administration, even if inadvertent, may cause death, convulsions, cerebral hemorrhage, coma, paralysis, arachnoiditis, acute renal failure, cardiac arrest, seizures, rhabdomyolysis, hyperthermia, and brain edema. IOMERVU is for intra-arterial or intravenous use only. (2.1, 5.1)
